name: Daily Maintenance — Blu Q Captain
source: KB: blu-q / Captain Blu Q Daily Maintenance
intro: One task per day, about 15 minutes. Check today's day and complete the matching task. These daily tasks keep Blu Q safe and in top condition.

help.title: Bilge inspection details
help.body: Check bilge pumps, ensure hulls are dry, pump out sugar scoops. Report any standing water or debris.

help.title: Snorkel gear inspection
help.body: Assist the mate with snorkel gear inspection. Check masks, snorkels, and fins for damage. Coordinate with mate on any items needing replacement or repair.

items.label: Wednesday: Organize and clean out bench lockers

help.title: Bench locker maintenance
help.body: Pull everything out, wipe down interior, organize contents, and remove anything that doesn't belong. Keep lockers tidy and functional.

items.label: Photo of bench lockers after cleaning (optional)
Thursday: Inventory the dock box, resupply as needed

help.title: Dock box inventory
help.body: Go through the dock box and inventory all items. Resupply anything that is low or missing. Note any items that need to be ordered.

items.label: Friday: Deck safety inspection or rig inspection as required

help.title: Safety and rig inspection
help.body: Walk the deck and check for any safety hazards — loose fittings, worn lines, damaged hardware. Inspect rig as required. Address or flag anything that needs attention.

items.label: Photo of any issues found (optional)
items.placeholder: Document any safety or rig issues

help.title: Aluminum care
help.body: Use Fitz cleaning solution and terry towel on all aluminum surfaces. Work methodically so nothing gets missed.

items.label: Sunday: Salt Away Sunday — spray all aluminum, flush motors, spray rams and fuel tank

help.title: Salt-Away procedure
help.body: Spray all aluminum surfaces with salt-away. Flush motors with salt-away solution. Spray rams and fuel tank. This weekly salt treatment prevents corrosion buildup.

completion.notes_prompt: Only check today's task. Any issues found during maintenance? Parts or supplies needed?
